# Zynverix

> Zynverix is an agency of three directors (Ahsan Khalid, Zain Ishaq, Ali Maan), working remotely from Pakistan with real estate agents, teams and small brokerages in the United States. We reply to every new buyer and seller lead within a minute, 24/7, sort it hot, warm or cold, and follow up until they book a showing or decline. We also run social media, video editing, Facebook and Instagram ads, websites and AI chatbots for agents.

Key facts:
- Focus: real estate agents and teams in the United States only.
- Clients can buy a single service; most start with lead management.
- We do not guarantee sales, revenue, leads, or ROI. We commit to reply speed, follow-up consistency, qualification, and tracking.
- Automated texts are only sent where the lead has given the required consent (TCPA).
- Free 15-minute audit. Contact: info@zynverix.com

## Services
- [Social Media Marketing](https://zynverix.com/services/social-media-marketing/): A content plan, listing posts, carousels, captions, scheduling and page management for real estate agents and teams on Instagram and Facebook.
- [Video Editing](https://zynverix.com/services/video-editing/): Reels, listing tour videos and agent intro videos edited from your footage, with captions, music and your branding, ready to post.
- [Facebook & Instagram Ads](https://zynverix.com/services/facebook-instagram-ads/): Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns for real estate agents: listing ads, buyer and seller lead campaigns, creatives, copy and targeting, connected to instant follow-up.
- [Website Design & Development](https://zynverix.com/services/web-design/): Agent websites and landing pages built to book showings and valuations: fast, mobile-first, with booking, lead capture and instant follow-up built in.
- [AI Chatbots](https://zynverix.com/services/ai-chatbots/): An AI chat assistant for your real estate website and Instagram/Facebook DMs that answers buyer questions 24/7, collects details and offers a showing time.
- [Lead Management (AI Automation)](https://zynverix.com/services/lead-management/): Every Zillow, Facebook and website lead gets an instant reply, is sorted hot, warm or cold, is followed up and offered a showing time. Built for real estate agents.
- [CRM Setup & Management](https://zynverix.com/services/crm-setup/): CRM setup and management for real estate agents: one clean pipeline with every lead, stage and task, connected to your follow-up, plus a weekly report.
- [Full-Stack Marketing](https://zynverix.com/services/digital-marketing/): Social media, video, ads, website, AI chatbot, lead management and CRM, run as one plan for your real estate business.
